title: Not so much...
text: I received my glow box today, and I'm a little disappointed. One mask had no English on it at all, which isn't problematic because I thought I could go to the information blog. However, upon scanning the qr code, I read the description and realized that I received just one of the products listed in the description of products. Of course there are variations in sub boxes, but only one item? I think I might have been happier with the two skincare items shown as opposed to the two I received. I've gone ahead and canceled because I think that I can do a better job of picking products from k beauty sites based on some reading. Live and learn, I guess.
label: neutral
